title: Apple’s John Ternus Leads Design; Touch-Screen OLED MacBook Pro Gets Lighter
summary: Also: A big update on the touch-screen MacBook Pro.

title: Trump Taps Clayton for AI Task Force in Response to Safety Fears
summary: President Donald Trump said he appointed Jay Clayton, his director of national intelligence, to help lead a White House task force on artificial intelligence as the fast-moving technology raises concerns about its safety risks.

title: 48 Hours in the Singapore With No Smartphone
summary: Bloomberg Pursuits Senior Features Writer Thu-Huong Ha tells Bloomberg This Weekend about spending 48 hours in Singapore without relying on a smartphone, navigating a city where transportation, payments, dining and government services are deeply integrated with digital technology. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ha says the experiment required more patience and effort but also made her more observant of her surroundings and convinced her there is value in experiencing boredom without immediately reaching for a screen. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Names Clayton, Ferguson to Lead AI Task Force
summary: The “Super Intelligence Force” will be led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and chairman of the Federal Trade Commission Andrew Ferguson, President Donald Trump says on Truth Social.

title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Has Rare Cautionary Note on AI Safety
summary: SoftBank Group Corp. chief Masayoshi Son — one of AI’s fervent believers — said that even he’s worried about safety risks as machines quickly gain more abilities.

title: Korea Orders Security Checks After Finance-Sector Data Leaks
summary: South Korean regulators urged financial institutions to promptly complete internal security inspections and report the results to authorities after a series of cyberattacks led to personal data breaches across the industry.

title: Britain’s Reliance on US Cloud Giants Alarms Its Politicians
summary: The UK’s dependence on big American cloud providers poses “a strategic and economic vulnerability” to the country, politicians warned, as US authorities have the power to switch off Britain’s public services or demand personal information under federal law.

title: Bessent Says AI Industry Must Own Its Risks and Find Solutions
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent criticized prominent artificial-intelligence figures’ warnings about existential risks posed by the technology as alarmist and unhelpful, calling on the industry to police itself and produce solutions.

title: US Hackers Face $1,000 Monthly Pay Cut in Controversial Plan
summary: US soldiers tasked with hacking American adversaries and defending the nation’s computers are set to see their incentive pay cut by as much as $12,000 a year as part of an overhaul that’s drawn ire from the ranks, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg and people familiar with the situation.

title: OpenAI Employee Quits With Call for Nuclear-Level Safeguards
summary: An OpenAI employee focused on AI safety has quit the company and warned that top artificial intelligence firms aren’t doing enough to mitigate the technology’s risks, joining a growing chorus of employees raising alarms from within the industry.
